name: Hardy Transplant
text: You're an unstoppable transplant who has adapted to thrive in brutal environments vastly different from the lush forests of Castrovel. You always count as adapted to a planet's environment, and you always take half damage from environmental effects such as from cold, heat, or corrosive atmospheres.

name: Harmonic Convergence
text: Dissonance grants you some clarity and a brief second wind in stressful situations. When you use an action with the disharmony trait, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level until the start of your next turn.

name: Harmonic Convergence
text: Dissonance grants you some clarity and a brief second wind in stressful situations. When you use an action with the disharmony trait, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level until the start of your next turn.

name: Harmonic Sensitivity
text: You've developed keen organs that have a sensitivity to sound—and you know how to put them to use. You become trained in Performance or gain the Assurance skill feat with Performance if you're are already trained in that skill. In addition, you can accurately recall a melody or lyrics you've heard within the last week, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to all Deception and Performance checks that involve mimicking speech or a specific sound.

name: Harmonic Shielding
text: You've learned to compensate for your hypersensitivity to sound. You gain sonic resistance equal to half your level. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a sonic effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Harmonist
text: Your music resonates with supernatural power. You can use your voice to cast ghost sound and message as innate cantrips at will.

name: Harness Cosmic Forces
text: You're among the most powerful of sarcesians and can harness the cosmic forces of the universe to create incredible stellar phenomena. Select one of the following spells, which you can cast once per day as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell: Eclipse Burst or Sunburst.

name: Harnessing Fate
text: You have become a master at manipulating the ebb and flow of fortune's fickle tide. When you gain the reaction, you only become immune to for 10 minutes.

name: Head of Steam
text: One talphi saying states that life is better in motion, and many talphis are better in motion as well; it takes you a second to get up to speed, but your body is built to capitalize on the momentum you generate. The more you move, the faster you go. Your Speed increases by 5 feet until the beginning of your next turn after each action you spend to Stride.

name: Headstrong
text: You became a borai through your own stubborn willfulness. When you died, you refused to accept your death and clung to your corpse, forcing your soul back into your body and regaining life along with it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saving throws against fear and effects that would make you Confused or Controlled and to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you.

name: Healing Mines
text: You gain the Healing Mines mod (exocortex): your mines heal the amount of Hit Points they would have dealt as damage.

name: Healing Touch
text: Once per day, you can touch a creature to heal it as a 2-action activity, restoring HP equal to your mystic level × your Wisdom modifier without expending a spell slot.

name: Heart of a Sun
text: You have the soul of a true sun and are impervious to even the hottest flames. You become immune to fire.

name: Heart of Planets Lost
text: You grew up hearing stories about Damiar and Iovo, the long-destroyed sarcesian home worlds remembered today only in legends, shattered rock, and the hearts of your people. You gain the general feat for Damiar Lore, Iovo Lore, and Diaspora Lore.

name: Heart of the Planets Lost
text: You grew up hearing stories about Damiar and Iovo, the long-destroyed sarcesian home worlds remembered today only in legends, shattered rock, and the hearts of your people.

name: Heavy Exoskeleton
text: Your chitinous plates have thickened in response to heavy punishment. Every bit of scar tissue that forms on your plates and every healed fracture have built your natural defenses into a protective layer that's truly a sight to behold. Your exoskeleton becomes heavy armor, and your proficiency in your exoskeleton armor becomes equal to your proficiency in medium armor. Your armor now grants a +5 item bonus to AC, has a +1 Dex cap, a check penalty of –2, a –10-foot penalty to Speed, and a Strength threshold of +3. It has a Bulk of 3 and the bulwark, comfort, and exposed traits. It's in the plate armor group. You can wear flight suits, but no other armor.

name: Heavy Shell
text: Your shell is structured in such a way to allow for easier movement of objects. Increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 4. You can rest normally while wearing medium armor.

name: Heed the Hive Mind
text: The queen and other members of your colony are ever-present in your mind. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that would directly control your actions, you get a critical success instead. Special If you have the queen's court formian heritage, when you roll a critical failure on a saving throw against an effect that would directly control your actions, you get a failure instead.

name: Hefty Hauler
text: You can carry more than most. Increase your Bulk limit by 2.

name: Heightened Metabolic Adaptation
text: Your body can adapt and change even faster than most other copaxis. You can retrain using your Regenerative Evolution feature over 1 week of downtime instead of 1 month. At 13th level, you can use regenerative evolution to retrain one feat or skill increase during your daily preparations. You can't use regenerative evolution to retrain Heightened Metabolic Adaptation.

name: Heightened Paranoia
text: You witnessed the ritual that supposedly rekindled Sota's flame up close, and while it was certainly impressive, you don't believe it should've worked. You can't seem to shake the feeling that something else is at work behind the scenes—something dangerous and unknown. Whatever it is, you intend to face this threat head on. When you succeed on a Will saving throw against an effect that could impose the Confused, Controlled, or Frightened condition, you get a critical success instead. Special You can't select this feat if you have the Determined Optimist feat.

name: Heightened Thoughtsense
text: Your psychic awareness expands, granting you sharper perception at close range and a wider sensory field overall. Increase the range of your vague thoughtsense by 10 feet. In addition, you gain thoughtsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 5 feet. At 9th level, your vague thoughtsense becomes an imprecise sense.

name: Hellfire
text: When facing overly moralizing and self-righteous foes, you can deploy hellfire to take them down a peg. Whenever you use a dragon ancestry ability that deals damage dependent on your associated damage type, instead of dealing only fire damage, you can choose to deal half fire damage and half evil damage instead of dealing only fire damage. This is especially useful against creatures like celestials with a weakness to evil damage.

name: Hellknight Dedication
text:
Your infernal countenance is a scourge. You gain expert proficiency in Intimidation (or in another skill in which you're trained of your choice if you were already an expert in Intimidation). You become trained in light armor and medium armor. If you already were trained in light armor and medium armor, you gain training in heavy armor as well. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in any type of armor (but not unarmored defense), you also gain that proficiency in the armor types granted to you by this feat. You gain the armor specialization effects of that armor and one additional armor upgrade. Your resistance (or reduction from critical hits) from that armor's specialization is 1 higher than normal and you gain an item bonus to Intimidation checks equal to 1 + your armor's resilience value.

name: Helping Hand
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes In the blink of an eye, you ready yourself to help your ally with a task. This counts as preparing to help an ally for the purposes of using the Aid reaction. You must still explain to the GM exactly how you're helping.

name: Hero's Edge
text: You fight hardest when the odds are at their most dire, and the specter of death looms over you. As long as you have temporary Hit Points from Heroic Last Stand, your Strikes and spells deal additional damage. You gain a status bonus to damage with your Strikes equal to the number of weapon damage dice. Spells you cast from spell slots gain a status bonus to damage equal to the level of the spell; this bonus applies only to spells that deal damage and don't have a duration.

name: Hero's Perseverance
text: Like the heroes who inspire you, you rally yourself to persevere against death itself. When you use Heroic Last Stand, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level for 1 minute, rather than equal to your level for 1 minute.

name: Heroic Last Stand
text: Frequency once per day Requirements You have less than one-quarter of your Hit Points remaining. You fight fearlessly for your friends. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute. As long as you have these temporary Hit Points, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to Demoralize you.

name: Hey, Buddy
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You fail a saving throw Requirements You're adjacent to at least one ally. You fly better with a copilot or a trusted ally you've formed a tight bond with. Reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result. If your ally also rolled a saving throw against the same effect, they can reroll the triggering saving throw and use the better result.

name: Hidden Hands
text: Your vestigial hands might lack in strength, but they make up for it in subtlety. You can manipulate objects with your smaller middle limbs while pretending to be otherwise occupied, drawing attention away from your clandestine activities. You gain the Subtle Theft feat. As long as your primary hands are holding or wielding items other than an infiltrator's toolkit, the circumstance penalty to notice your misdeeds extends to attempts to [[/act disarm]] a Device or Pick a Lock.

name: Hidden Identity
text: Unlike others with the power of song, you like to be able to fly under the radar when you need to. You've developed a second identity in the process. You become trained in Deception. If you're already trained in Deception, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Favored Disguise skill feat, and the Skitter Idol Transformation activity.

name: Hidden Talent
text: You have niche expertise or esoteric training that you often fall back on when you find yourself in a rut. You gain the One Up reaction.

name: High Voltage
text: Your drone gains the Electrical Discharge action (two actions): it deals 1d6 electricity damage in a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line (basic Reflex vs your class DC) and can't do so again for 1d4 rounds. The damage increases by 1d6 for every 2 levels you have.

name: High-Tech Medic
text: You can store up to 3 items with the healing trait in your custom rig, and gain the Concentrated Dosage mod (a powerful dose that lowers a clumsy/sickened value or suppresses persistent damage) and, with a drone, the Healbot mod (your drone administers a healing item, healing extra HP equal to your Int modifier or half the item's level).

name: Historian
text: You become trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You can spend 10 minutes checking your notes or research materials to Recall Knowledge about a piece of history with any Lore skill in which you aren't trained, using your highest Lore skill modifier instead of your modifier with that skill.

name: History Buff
text: You've cataloged countless customs, histories, and traditions. You can cast hypercognition once per day as a 3rd-rank occult innate spell. You can use your modifier for the Lore skill you chose for Historian in place of any other skill modifier when attempting a Recall Knowledge check while casting Hypercognition.

name: Hive Coordination
text: Your hive instincts make you an exceptional team combatant. When you Aid an ally, the bonus increases by 1, and you can Aid as a free action once per round.

name: Hive Mind Attunement
text: You can briefly attune to nearby shirren, gaining advantage on checks to coordinate with them. Once per day, when you Aid another shirren, you automatically succeed.

name: Hoard Deposit
text:
Frequency once per day

You maintain a connection to your hoard at any distance, allowing you to deposit items into your hoard from afar. You spend 10 minutes concentrating on your mental image of your hoard to transfer up to 3 Bulk of non-living, non-magical objects to your hoard.

name: Hoard Hauler
text: You've carried around enough of your hoard with you from place to place that it's become much easier for you to lift and carry more than your size and Strength would indicate. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Athletics, or trained in a different skill of your choice if you were already trained in Athletics. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.

name: Hoard Warder
text: You've learned to use abjurations to alert you of burglars coming after your hoard, and you can put the same magic to use to protect your camp at night. You can cast Alarm once per day as an innate spell of your heritage's tradition.

name: Hobnobber
text: You're skilled at working a crowd. You can Gather Information in half the usual time, and when you do so over the normal duration you gain a +2 circumstance bonus.

name: Hold Hands
text: Requirements You are adjacent to an ally. You learned that supporting members of your pair or pod also makes you stronger. You join hands with an adjacent willing ally, which occupies one of each of your hands. For 1 round, while you remain adjacent to that ally and holding hands, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. Additionally, you and your ally gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your saving throws against attempts to [[/act demoralize]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] either of you.

name: Hold the Line
text: Frequency: once per day As part of your daily preparations, you make a motivating speech to 10 or fewer allies. Your allies must be able to perceive you during this time, but this doesn't otherwise impede their own preparation. When one of these allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points and isn't immediately killed, you can call out to them to ignite their sense of duty. The creature avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 Hit Point, and its wounded condition increases by 1. Additionally, it gains a +5 foot status bonus to its Speed until the end of its next turn and a +1 status bonus to its first attack before the end of its next turn.

name: Hold the Link
text: When you're psychically harmed, it causes pain you won't soon forget, but you've learned to grab hold of that pain and share it with your psychic attacker, to teach them what it feels like. When you use the Shared Link reaction, after you resolve its effects, the targeted creature takes a –1 status penalty to saves against mental effects and has a weakness to mental effects equal to half your level until the end of your next turn. Special If the target has resistance (but not immunity) to mental damage, it instead loses its resistance for the duration.

name: Hologram Skeptic
text: Experience with illusions and holograms has sharpened your senses. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to disbelieve illusions and holographic projections.

name: Home Turf
text: Whether it's your apartment, laboratory, or starship, your senses are particularly keen in the place you call home. Select one familiar location to be your home turf. While in your home turf, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth, Survival, and Perception checks and DCs. You lose this bonus for 24 hours if there are any major alterations to your home turf, including temporary or illusory changes to the environment from the use of spells and effects that cause difficult terrain, temporary structures, and many witchwarper abilities. You don't lose your bonus due to changes in light level, gravity, or temperature (unless those changes cause significant alterations to the environment, such as starting a fire).

name: Homebrewed Core
text:
You were originally designed or built by an independent foundry, without some of the restrictions and safety mechanisms that would be in place for most other xenometric android production facilities. Choose one of the following.
You're one size larger than your ancestry, up to Large. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks to . Add the Stretching Reach standardized ancestry feat to your available standardized ancestry feats.
You're one size smaller than your ancestry but no smaller than Small. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to and . Add the LK6niBb38mEraYRS standardized ancestry feat to your available standardized ancestry feats.
You have an additional pair of limbs but can only have one pair active at a time. You can change which of your limbs are active with the Switch Hands action. Add the All Hands on Deck and Double Draw standardized ancestry feats to your available standardized ancestry feats.

name: Homegrown Skills
text: By avoiding relying on superfluous augmentations, you have sharpened your senses and your skills. During daily preparations, when choosing a skill for , you can also choose an additional skill feat that you qualify for in that same skill.

name: Homeguard
text: Your Homeguard training has prepared you for anything. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, and when you tie an adversary's initiative roll, you always go first.

name: Homing Mote
text: You've come to rely on ranged motes as much as you do your solar weapon. Triple the range increment of your solar flare. When you make a solar flare Strike against a target within your first range increment, you ignore the target's concealment and cover.

name: Homing Mote
text: You've come to rely on ranged motes as much as you do your solar weapon. Triple the range increment of your solar flare. When you make a solar flare Strike against a target within your first range increment, you ignore the target's concealment and cover.

name: Horn-Cone Mastery
text: Your horn-cones have grown far more sensitive, as you've finally achieved some semblance of your ancestors' ability to hunt through psychic mastery alone and can track the locations of thinking creatures with incredible accuracy. Your thoughtsense becomes a precise sense.

name: Horns of the Hunter
text: Though your psychic abilities still pale in comparison to your ancient worlanisi kin, you've honed the sensitivity of your horn-cones so that you can better triangulate your prey based on stray thoughts hanging in the environment around you. The range of your imprecise thoughtsense increases to 30 feet, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to [[/act track rollOption="horns-of-the-hunter"]] thinking creatures that aren't otherwise immune to mental effects.

name: Host's Final Gift
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the dying condition or would otherwise die. Requirements You have a willing host. In a final act of bravery and gratitude, your host has decided that preserving your gift of intelligence is more important than preserving itself. Your host prevents you from dying and takes the brunt of whatever force would cause you to die, allowing your body to absorb its rapidly decaying form and regain Hit Points equal to ]{6d8 plus half your level}. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the doomed condition, you lose the condition or effect as the host creature dies in your stead. You lose the benefits of your heritage and any ancestry feats that require your heritage or having a host until you can find and merge with another host.

name: Hostile Gravity
text: Frequency once per day You extend your innate ability to alter your personal gravity to harm another creature within 120 feet, the intense pressure buckling their bones. You deal ] damage to the creature with a save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature also becomes and Slowed 1 until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Hot Ride
text: One gobbo's junk heap is your own hot ride. You learn the formula for four tech vehicles of your level or lower. Vehicles you gain a .

name: Hug Master
text: A good, solid hug makes everything better, and you're bringing hugs to the battlefield. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Grapple and to your Fortitude DC to avoid being Grappled.

name: Hulking Corpsefolk
text: You're a mountain of flesh, having managed to increase your girth in irreversible ways. Perhaps you absorbed enough physical material to do so, or maybe you've completed mysterious, inexplicable necromantic rituals. Increase your size category to Large, and increase your reach by 5 feet.

name: Hull Hop
text: A starship hull can be a dangerous place. When the need arises, you can use your internal hydraulics to launch yourself to safety. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed for 10 minutes.

name: Hunker Down
text: Two actions: you Stride and Take Cover, then either Detonate Mine, make a ranged Strike with your turret, or have your drone Strike.

name: Hunker Down
text: Trigger You would be hit by a ranged attack. When the shooting starts, everyone envies the one with the armored shell on their back. You Drop Prone, hiding beneath the thickest parts of your exoskeleton to avoid some of the damage. You gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1) while you're Prone this way.

name: Hunter's Leap
text: The key to a good jump isn't speed, and it isn't technique. It's a powerful set of legs, and you've got some of the strongest. You gain the Powerful Leap skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites. You treat all falls as if they were 10 feet less than the actual distance traveled, or 40 feet less if you're falling immediately after you Leap.

name: Hurl Ally
text: Requirements You are adjacent to an ally or your ally is riding you and you have one or more hands free. You use your innate strength to hurl an ally across the battlefield. Pick up an adjacent ally of your size or smaller and throw them to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet, or within 40 feet if you throw your bonded partner. Their movement doesn't trigger reactions. Your ally ends this movement on their feet and treats the fall as 20 feet lower, or 40 feet lower if you throw your bonded partner.

name: Hurry
text: You urge an ally to pick up the pace and contribute more to the events happening around them. One ally within 30 feet who can sense you becomes Quickened for 1 round. They can use the extra action to Interact, Step, or Stride. The target is then temporarily immune to Hurry for the next 10 minutes.

name: Hurry
text: You urge an ally to pick up the pace and contribute more to the events happening around them. One ally within 30 feet who can sense you becomes for 1 round. They can use the extra action to Interact, Step, or Stride. The target is then temporarily immune to Hurry for the next 10 minutes.

name: Hush
text: Frequency once per day You fall utterly silent and focus strenuously on a problem at hand. You attempt to Recall Knowledge with a +2 circumstance bonus to the skill check. If you would get a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and if you would get a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Hybrid Technique
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. You can combine methods into a deadly new hybrid technique. Choose two soldier feats that take 2 actions to use, require you to wield an area or automatic weapon, and cause you to make an Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack as part of its effects. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire once and then apply the additional effects and benefits of both selected feats to the attack.

name: Hybrid Technique
text:
Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

You can combine methods into a deadly new hybrid technique. Choose two soldier feats that take 2 actions to use, require you to wield an area or automatic weapon, and cause you to make an Area Fire or Auto-Fire attack as part of its effects. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire once and then apply the additional effects and benefits of both selected feats to the attack.

name: Hyper
text: Your boundless enthusiasm propels you into action. Once per day as a free action at the start of your turn, you gain an additional action that you can only use to Stride or Strike.

name: Hyperfixated Researcher
text: You're notorious for your discipline to the point that you can leverage your fame to ask favors of fans and colleagues. You can use the Lore skill that you gain from to . You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] on people interested in your chosen discipline. If you're legendary in the Lore skill, this circumstance bonus increases to +4.

name: Hyperfocus Speed
text:
Frequency once per day

You've learned how to harness all your magical potential directly into fly Speed, allowing you to move extremely quickly in exchange for restricting your use of magic for a time. For up to 10 minutes, you gain a fly Speed of 100 feet, or increase your fly Speed to 100 feet if you already had one. You additionally gain a +20-foot status bonus to this fly Speed, for a total fly Speed of 120 feet. This effect lasts for up to 10 minutes. While the effect lasts, you can't Cast Spells or Activate most magic items, though you can still drink potions. You can Dismiss the effect.

name: Hypertelepathy
text: Your connection to a hive mind gives you even greater telepathic potential than most other telepathic species can even dream of. Increase the range of your limited telepathy to 200 feet. Once per day, when you Recall Knowledge, you can use the skill modifier of a willing ally within range of your telepathy instead of your own.

name: I Can't Tell If You're Flirting
text: Sometimes, the subtlety of sarcasm and innuendo is lost on you. You respond better to direct communication. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against mental effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect, you get a critical success instead. If you roll a failure to [[/act coerce]] or Influence a creature, you get a critical failure instead.

name: I'll Be Back
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You regain consciousness after being Unconscious. Even when you're downed, you get right back into the thick of things once recovered. You Stand and Interact to draw a weapon or grab an unattended weapon.

name: I'll Be Back
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You regain consciousness after being .

Even when you're downed, you get right back into the thick of things once recovered. You Stand and Interact to draw a weapon or grab an unattended weapon.

name: I'm No Rat
text: You can tell especially convincing lies when it comes to protecting others. When you [[/act lie]] to authority figures to protect someone else, you can roll twice and use the better result. If your Lie is found out, you can't use this effect on that authority figure again until you've regained their trust (usually by improving their attitude toward you).

name: I'm the Real One
text: Trigger You become Grabbed or Restrained by another creature or you grab or restrain another creature. Requirements You can use Change Shape to assume the appearance of that creature. You Change Shape to assume the appearance of the other creature. All other creatures must use the Seek action to attempt a Perception check against your Deception DC to determine which creature is real and which is an imitation. A creature who doesn't know which creature you are must succeed at a flat|dc:11 when targeting either of you with an attack, spell, or other effect. If the check fails, the attack, spell, or effect targets the other creature instead. Abilities such as telepathy or the mystic's group chat feature may automatically allow a creature to determine which creature is which, but an aware creature must still use the Point Out action to indicate to others which creature is which. An imitated creature might have a signal or phrase that indicates to their allies which creature is which, but doing so in the din of battle is an action with the auditory or visual trait.

name: Ice Climb
text: You can scramble over ice with ease. You gain an ice climb Speed equal to your land Speed; this is a climb Speed that you can use only to climb ice. Additionally, you ignore difficult terrain from ice and snow, and you don't risk falling prone from uneven ground that is uneven only due to ice.

name: Icy Spelunker
text: You spent time exploring the icy caves of Kalo-Mahoi's crust, and climbing comes nearly as easily to you as walking. You gain a Climb speed of 25 feet, and you treat difficult terrain from ice and snow as normal terrain.

name: Ignoble Deed
text: You trick an enemy into embarrassing itself. Attempt a Deception check against the enemy's Will DC. On a success, the enemy is flat-footed until the end of its next turn and takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls.

name: Ignore Radiation
text: Exposure to low levels of cosmic radiation over a long period of time has made your cells more resilient. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poison; this bonus increases to +2 against radiation.

name: Ikeshti Lore
text: Life on Akiton is hard, but thanks to your brood-minder, you learned the skills necessary to thrive. You become trained in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Ikeshti Lore.

name: Immense Gravity
text: You exude a much stronger gravitational field than most novians, enabling you to exert your personal gravity upon your surroundings from a farther distance. Your reach increases to 10 feet. In addition, you double the range of all the following novian feats you possess: Gravity Grasp and Gravity Swipe.

name: Impeccable Crafting
text: Your craftsmanship is exceptional. When you succeed at a Crafting check to make an item, you gain the benefits of a critical success on the cost reduction.

name: Impeding Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You hinder your target with a shot. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the target is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn. If the target is flying, it also falls 10 feet.

name: Impeding Shot
text:
Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You hinder your target with a shot. You and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If the Strike hits, the target is Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn. If the target is flying, it also falls 10 feet.

name: Impenetrable Mind
text: You resist mental control with supernatural skill. You become immune to the Confused and Controlled conditions. Whenever you gain the Stupefied condition, you immediately reduce the value of the condition by 1. This feat doesn't apply if you impose the condition on yourself.

name: Imperious Nature
text: Your legendary abilities set you apart from the rest of humanity, and you can project an air of majesty that inspires compliance in those around you. Once per day, you can cast as a 7th-rank occult innate spell using the higher of your class DC or spell DC (). Because you're projecting your presence more so than words, this effect loses the linguistic trait.

name: Implacable Grappler
text: You combine your impressive stature and additional limbs to become a fierce wrestler. You gain the Titan Wrestler skill feat and a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against Grapple or Grab attempts.

name: Impressive Lungs
text: You have excellent lung capacity. You gain the Breath Control general feat. You do not need to breathe for up to 10 minutes after leaving a vacuum.

name: Impressive Performance
text: Your performances make a lasting impression. When you Make an Impression using Performance, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check and the effect lasts an additional day.

name: Impressive Storage
text: Your ability to compress and store objects within your own body is unparalleled. The amount of material you can store in the extradimensional space within your body increases to 50 Bulk.

name: Improv Workshop
text: Your stage experience has taught you how to improvise in just about any situation, and you know how to share your insight with others. You gain the Untrained Improvisation general feat. In addition, you gain the Once More with Feeling action.

name: Improved Conductivity
text: By imitating your ancestors' diet, taking synthetic supplements, or unlocking your genetic potential with magic, you've enhanced your bioelectrical network. All your Strikes or spells that deal electricity damage or have the electricity trait gain the arc trait. If you're wielding an active forcefield, it regenerates twice its normal HP for 1 round after you hit an enemy with an arc attack.

name: Improved Elebrian Magic
text: Choose one 3rd-rank or lower arcane spell. You can cast that spell as a 3rd-rank arcane innate spell once per day. If this is your 13th-level ancestry feat, instead choose a 5th-rank or lower arcane spell, and you can cast it as a 5th-rank arcane innate spell once per day. If this is your 17th-level ancestry feat, instead choose a 7th-rank or lower arcane spell, and you can cast it as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per day. Special You can select this feat more than once. If you do, you must select a different spell.

name: Improved Knockdown
text: Your melee blows put enemies on the ground. When you hit with a melee Strike, you can attempt to knock the target prone as a free follow-up (no additional attack roll on a critical hit).

name: Improved Seismic Sensitivity
text: Like the ancient kucharn, you've honed your underground senses to detect faraway threats. Increase the range of your tremorsense to 120 feet.

name: Improved Storage
text: Your body is a literal black hole, capable of absorbing and compressing material within yourself. The amount of material you can store in the extradimensional space within your body increases to 2 Bulk.

name: Improved Undead Senses
text: Your ability to sense living and undead energies improves, and you learn how to differentiate between entities you can sense in an area. Your lifesense becomes a precise sense with a range of 60 feet.

name: Improvised Construction
text: Though your surroundings might have changed, you're adept at bending them to your purposes: you grab whatever is close at hand and build your own tools, shelters, and in this case, protection. Where others might struggle to find cover from enemy fire, you can piece together safety from the most meager supplies. You gain the Barricade general feat. If you construct a barricade in a natural environment, it falls apart after two turns instead of at the end of your next turn.

name: Improvised Legend
text: You can use Improvised Mastery once per hour, rather than twice per day.

name: In Another Life
text: Whenever you rest, you behold different versions of yourself in other realities. During your daily preparations, select one ancestry feat for your ancestry that you meet the prerequisites for and don't already have. You gain that feat until your next daily preparations.

name: In Hylax's Name
text: You've studied under some of the foremost Hylaxian scholars in the galaxy deep in the Forever Halls, or another center of worship, to gain a greater understanding of the Forever Queen's teachings. You carry the evidence of those studies with you in the form of a religious symbol, relic of your faith, or other meaningful memento. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Student of the Canon feat.

name: In the Face of Danger
text: Your exemplary courage and mental fortitude carry you through the most daunting of situations. When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to [[/act demoralize]] you.

name: Incognito Spell
text: [one-action] If your next action is to Cast a Spell, the spell gains the subtle trait, hiding the spellcasting actions and manifestations (but not its effects).

name: Incredible Ferocity
text: You are an implacable foe whose ability to escape death is nearly unrivaled. You can use Shobhad Ferocity once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Incredible Initiative
text: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.

name: Incredible Palette
text: Your sense of taste is preternatural, and you can safely ingest all sorts of things. You gain the Supertaster general feat, even if you don't meet the Perception prerequisite. You also gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against things you ingest, such as ingested poisons and diseases. If you roll a success on such a saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

name: Incredible Tenacity
text: As you've progressed through life, you've taken your role as a stalwart worker to heart, and your bloodline surges to support you in your duties. You can use Madrosarai Tenacity with a frequency of once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Independent LFAN
text: Frequency once per day You have a rudimentary artificial intelligence in your LFAN that you can activate to accelerate your LFAN-based activities. You become Quickened for 1 minute. You can spend this extra action only to Strike with a weapon held in your LFAN, Interact with an object with your LFAN, or perform an action with the LFAN trait. Special if you have the Brawler LFAN feat, you can spend this extra action to [[/act disarm]], [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]].

name: Inexorable
text: The plant or fungus your body is based upon has a penchant for becoming a multi-planetary invasive species. When you're not on your home world, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. When you succeed at a saving throw against an affliction that's benefiting from this bonus, you improve your condition by 2 stages (or by 1 stage if the affliction is virulent).

name: Infernal Armaments
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes
You infuse your weapons with the might of Hell. For the next minute, on your first weapon Strike each round, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice; this extra damage is determined by your chosen Hellknight order.

name: Infernal Bulwark
text: Armor you wear gains the bulwark trait. You become trained in heavy armor, or become an expert in heavy armor if you were already trained. Your Hellknight regalia grants you resistance equal to half your level when you wear it, determined by your chosen Hellknight order.

name: Infinite Aim
text: You're a sharpshooter who doesn't need a scope or stance to shoot your best shot. You can Aim as a free action.

name: Infinite Ammo Trick
text:
Frequency once every 2 rounds
You forget how many shots you've taken, and for a second, so does reality. Make a Strike with a weapon you're wielding. This Strike doesn't use any ammo or battery usage. You don't apply any benefits from special ammunition to this Strike.

name: Infinite Magic
text: You borrow spells from other realities. Twice per day, you can cast a 9th-rank or lower spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.

name: Infinite Magic
text: You borrow spells from other realities. Twice per day, you can cast a 9th-rank or lower spell after you've run out of spell slots of the appropriate spell rank; the two spells you cast with this feat must be of different spell ranks.

name: Infinite Worlds
text: You pull materials from other realities to serve your needs. Once per day, you can spend 1 minute in concentration to conjure a mundane non-magical item of up to 1,000 credits in value from an alternate timeline. The item disappears after 24 hours.

name: Influence

With masterful timing and a careful choice of words, you can manipulate the emotions and thoughts of others. You roll the triggering Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check twice, and use the higher result.

name: Infodump
text: You muster myriad minutiae that you subsequently use to overwhelm a creature's mind with pointless trivia. Attempt a check to Recall Knowledge against the Will DC of a creature you're aware of within 60 feet; you can use any skill for which you can Recall Knowledge, not just a skill associated with the target's traits. Rather than remembering useful information, you recite facts at the target. Regardless of your result, the creatures within 60 feet become temporarily immune to your attempts to Infodump with that skill for 24 hours. Critical Success The target is Stupefied 2 for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. Success The target is Stupefied 1 for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. Failure The target is unaffected. Critical Failure You trip over your own thoughts, becoming stupefied 1 until the beginning of your next turn. Special You can Infodump using speech or limited telepathy. If you Infodump through speech, this ability gains the auditory trait.

name: Infrasonic Blast
text: You channel infrasound into a debilitating pulse. Once per day as a 2-action activity, creatures within 20 feet must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + level + CON modifier) or become sickened 1 and deafened for 1 round.

name: Infused Spell
text: You infuse your magic with vital energy that empowers the target of your spell. Pick a spell and reduce your vitality network's total by a number equal to twice the spell's rank. If your next action is to cast that spell, one bonded ally you target with that spell becomes Quickened until the end of your next turn and can use the extra action for only Strike and Stride actions.

name: Inheritor of Star's Glory
text: Frequency once per day You are the prime inheritor of your progenitor star's power and can don this star's lost legacy as a crown, growing in size and power, resplendent in glory. You become Small (or Medium, if you're a massive novian). Your equipment grows with you but returns to normal size if removed. You gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage and Intimidation checks, and the area of your solar luminance (and Absorb Light, if you're a black hole novian) is doubled. This transformation lasts for 1 minute. You can end this glorious transformation early as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

name: Inner Ear Temblor
text: Nothing escapes your ears so long as they move even an inch. You gain tremorsense as a vague sense with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your ears to determine if a creature is present, but you can't pinpoint their location. Creatures that haven't moved or don't make sounds (such as those under the effects of a silence spell) remain undetected to you.

name: Inner Peace
text: You never lose your cool. When you become Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL or Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg, you immediately reduce the value of the condition by 1. When you would gain the Confused or Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr condition, you can attempt a flat|dc:16. On a success, you don't get the confused or controlled condition.

name: Inner Wellspring
text: Frequency once per day When you must endure times of extreme stress and pain, you dig deep and draw on the memories or stories of your lost ancestral home world of Golarion, tapping into inner reserves of power to pull off just one more miracle. You regain 1 Focus Point.

name: Insatiable Speedster
text: Even the natural limitations of your own biology won't get between you and your need for speed! You can use Need for Speed once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Insatiable Student
text: You're an insatiable student, determined to learn and experience everything you can, as quick as you can—even if the knowledge gained quickly gets buried under new information. During your daily preparations, you gain the Additional Lore feat with one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option, like a feat.

name: Insightful Jest
text: You know how to make quips and jokes that cut right to the heart of the matter, and potentially inspire others to do better by overcoming their faults. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy, or become trained in another skill if you were already trained in Diplomacy. You gain the Bon Mot skill feat. Unlike normally, you can also use Bon Mot against an ally during an encounter, exchanging in witty combat banter that pokes fun at your ally's flaws. If you do so and roll a critical success, you get a success instead. If an ally uses a skill action to remove the penalty from your Bon Mot and their check result meets or exceeds a standard DC for their level, their successful introspection grants them a +2 status bonus to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute. That ally is then temporarily immune to your Bon Mot for 1 day; there's only so much self reflection someone can perform in a single day.

name: Inspiring Boost
text: As a 2-action activity, you can grant temporary HP to an ally within 60 feet equal to your Charisma modifier + your envoy level. This temporary HP lasts until the start of your next turn.

name: Instant Deployment
text: Free action (Trigger: you roll initiative). If you have a drone exocortex, your drone Strides. If you have a mine or turret exocortex, you can Deploy Mine or Deploy Turret.

name: Instant Genetic Recall
text: You can quickly access your genetic database of knowledge and experiences. Choose a skill you're expert in that has the Recall Knowledge action. You gain the Assurance and Automatic Knowledge skill feats for the chosen skill. Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different skill each time.

name: Instant Install
text: If you use your custom rig (rather than a repair toolkit) to Install Upgrade, you can Install Upgrade as a single action.

name: Instinctive Aim
text: You draw your gun and take careful aim with the same motion. You Interact to draw a ranged weapon or Switch Hands and then Aim with that ranged weapon.

name: Instinctive Aim
text: You draw your gun and take careful aim with the same motion. You Interact to draw a ranged weapon or Switch Hands and then with that ranged weapon.

name: Instinctive Collaborator
text: Cooperation is a fundamental value on Raxil, and you were raised to always look for opportunities to work collaboratively with others. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid, and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid you.

name: Instinctive Hold
text: Trigger Your turn begins, and you're grabbing or restraining a creature within your reach. Directed by the sensitive nerves entwined within each of your limbs, your tentacles reflexively cling onto whatever you're grappling, even if your attention is directed elsewhere. Attempt a flat. If you succeed, you can extend the duration of the grappled creature's Grabbed or Restrained condition until the end of your next turn. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you [[/act grapple]] a creature, you can't use them as part of this action.

name: Instinctive Telepath
text: You've trained to telepathically communicate with anyone. The range of your limited telepathy increases to 100 feet. You can communicate with creatures that don't share your language with limited telepathy, and you permanently gain the effects of Truespeech.

name: Intensified Psychic Shock
text: You focus your telepathic attacks further, broadcasting your psychic power with greater range and area. Your psychic shock unarmed attack gains the boost (1d6) trait, requiring no battery to boost your attack. By spending 10 minutes in intense concentration, you can reconfigure your mind to apply one of the following benefits to your psychic shock. This benefit lasts until you reconfigure to another benefit. Extended Shock: Increase the range increment of your psychic shock by 15 feet. Mind Crusher: Your psychic shock gains the fatal d8 trait. Peer Pressure: Your psychic shock gains the arc trait, but it deals mental damage rather than electricity damage. Psychic Wave: Your psychic shock gains the splash trait.

name: Intensify Shell
text: Frequency once per day You channel your internal chemicals to enhance your shell, turning it into an additional layer of temporary protection. For 1 minute, you gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage, but you take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

name: Interdimensional Cheek Portal
text: You've made some dimensional adjustments to your cheek pouches for spacious storing, allowing you to defy the laws of physics. When you store items in your cheek pouches, they no longer significantly alter your speech. You can store up to 10 Bulk of items in your cheek pouches, and items stored in your cheek pouches can have a dimension longer than 1 foot, so long as they could still reasonably fit in your mouth. While stored in your extradimensional pouches, these items are virtually undiscoverable, and the DC to detect the items is equal to the higher of your class DC or spell DC + 10.

name: Internal Chemistry
text: You tweak your anatomy and bodily systems to metabolize pharmaceuticals more efficiently. Regain additional Hit Points equal to half your level when you restore Hit Points to yourself using a consumable item with the healing trait.

text: Your body can internally synthesize oxygen for limited periods of time.

name: Intestinal Fortitude
text: Many humans like to experiment when it comes to sampling alien flavors, and you consider yourself a connoisseur. As a result of you treating the galaxy like a smorgasbord, you've developed a strong immune system. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons. You reduce the DC of flat checks to recover from persistent poison damage from 15 to 10.

name: Intimidating Athlete
text: Your physique is so impressive that your acts of strength astound your foes. When you succeed or critically succeed at an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]], you can, as a free action, attempt an Athletics or Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] one creature within 30 feet. You also gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.

name: Intimidating Glare
text: You can Demoralize with a single withering glance. You can use Demoralize as a single action without the verbal component; this action has the Concentrate trait.

name: Intimidating Prowess
text: Your physical presence makes your threats more credible. You add your Strength modifier to Intimidation checks in addition to your Charisma modifier.

name: Intimidating Roar
text: You can unleash the same primal pahtra war cries as your ancient ancestors. You gain the Battle Cry skill feat. While your [[/act demoralize]] action still has the auditory trait, you don't take a penalty when you Demoralize a creature that doesn't speak your language. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Demoralize animals.

name: Intimidating Shot
text: A precise shot rattles your target. When you succeed at a ranged Strike, you can attempt to Demoralize the target as a free action.

name: Intimidating Taunt
text: You taunt your enemy mercilessly, forcing them to acknowledge you as an immediate threat. Attempt an intimidation|against:will check and compare it to the Will DC of one enemy creature within 60 feet. This action has the auditory trait or visual trait, depending on how you taunt your enemy. Critical Success Your taunts sting hard. Until the start of your next turn, any hostile actions that the creature takes must include you as a target or include you in the area; otherwise, the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls and to its save DC for those hostile actions. Success As critical success, but only the first hostile action that the creature takes is affected. Failure The creature is unaffected.

text:
Frequency once per hour
You enjoy embracing new experiences and have a knack for picking up new skills and talents, sometimes over the course of countless lifetimes, as your semi-dead nature grants you a wider perspective. Choose a skill that you're untrained in. Until the beginning of your next turn, you become trained in the chosen skill.

name: Inventor
text: You are a genius at Crafting, easily able to determine how things are made and create new inventions. You can spend downtime to invent a common formula that you don't know. This works just like the Craft activity: you spend half the Price of the formula up front, attempt a Crafting check, and on a success either finish the formula by paying the difference or work for longer to decrease the Price. The difference is that you spend the additional time in research, design, and development, rather than in creating an item. Once it's complete, you add the new formula you invented to your formula book. The GM might allow you to invent uncommon or rare formulas, typically with an increased DC. You need the Magical Crafting feat to invent hybrid and magical formula.

name: Invigorating Trinket
text: Frequency once per day One of your personal trinkets carries your memory of eager early mornings and the rush of energy to start a task. You grasp a personal trinket and allow it to invigorate you with a pleasant memory. You become Quickened for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round for only Strike and Stride actions.

name: Invoke Nightmare
text: You reach into a deep well of nightmare fuel and drown a target in a well of horror and despair. You can cast Agonizing Despair once per day as an innate occult spell.

name: Invoke the Leviathan
text: Frequency once per day A typical ijtikri's leviathan transformation is their last act in life, irreversibly swelling to immense size before seeding the sea with new life. You aren't typical; you can transform into a Gargantuan ijtikri leviathan battle form for 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect. When the effect ends, the revitalizing gases from your leviathan body fill a , restoring |options:area-damage] Hit Points to living creatures in the area. You gain the following statistics and abilities. AC = 22 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction. 10 temporary Hit Points. Speed 10 feet, fly 40 feet, swim 60 feet The following unarmed melee attacks. You're trained with this attack, and your attack modifier is +25. This attack is Strength based. If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead. Melee 1 tentacle (backswing, grapple, reach 30 feet), Damage 3d10+15 bludgeoning; Area Fire 2 wail (), Damage 3d10+15 sonic (basic Reflex save versus the higher of your class DC or spell DC) Acrobatics modifier of +15 and Athletics modifier of +25, unless your own modifiers are higher.

name: Iomedae's Barrage
text:
Frequency once per day
You channel your spirit into a mighty barrage from a celestial plasma cannon. Iomedae's barrage Auto-Fires in a or a , dealing , (floor(@actor.level/2 - 1))d6[spirit]|traits:holy] damage with the holy trait (). At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the fire and spirit damage each increase by 1d6. A creature that gets a critical failure on this Reflex save is also Blinded for 1 round.

name: Iomedae's Helm
text: You touch an adjacent ally who is affected by a spell or other magical effect with the mental trait due to failing a Will save and has a duration of no longer than 1 minute. That ally can immediately attempt a Will save against the effect's DC, ending the condition on a success. This can't end the effect for any creatures other than your target ally. Regardless of the result of the save, your ally is temporarily immune to Iomedae's Helm for 10 minutes.

name: Iomedae's Shield
text:
You manifest your faith as a shield. Your armor and the armor of up to five allies you can see within 30 feet gains the benefits of an activated Tactical Force Field upgrade with 14 Hit Points that replenishes 2 Hit Points on your turn but does not protect from critical hits like a normal force field. The force field lasts for one minute. After receiving the benefits of Iomedae's Shield, you and your allies are immune to the effect for one hour.

At level 10, this becomes a Superior Force Field with 26 HP and replenishes 5 Hit Points on your turn, and at level 16, this becomes an Ultimate Force Field with 37 HP and replenishes 7 Hit Points on your turn.

name: Iomedae's Sword
text: You've trained to fight the ancient enemies of lost Golarion. When you deal damage to a demon, devil, dragon, or undead with a weapon, you deal persistent spirit damage with the holy trait equal to the number of weapon damage dice. When you deal damage to one of these creatures with a spell cast from a spell slot that does not have a duration, you deal persistent spirit damage with the holy trait equal to the spell's rank.

name: Iron Guts
text: Nothing turns your stomach. When you succeed at a Fortitude save to retch, reduce your sickened value by 2 (or by 3 on a critical success). Any disease you contract with a level lower than your own loses the virulent trait.

name: Iron Will
text: Your mental fortitude is legendary. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

name: It Has Pockets!
text: The pockets you've created in your fur have strengthened, and you love finding ways to hold more choices for your friends in them. You gain the Prescient Planner general feat. You can use Prescient Planner as a 2-action activity once per day, and you can procure ammunition and batteries in addition to the usual items available. These items must meet the usual level, Bulk, and other requirements, and you must still pay the Price of the chosen item.

name: It's Who You Know
text: You call on your extensive network for help with skulduggery. When you Gather Information or Create a Forgery, you do it in half the normal time.

name: Item Mastery
text:
You can draw and fiddle with a magic item to make it work, allowing you to use scrolls, wands, and other sorts of items imbued with unfamiliar magic. You gain the Trick Magic Item skill feat as a bonus feat. You gain the Draw and Trick action.

Draw and Trick: Effect You Interact to draw a magic item and then Trick that Magic Item.

name: Izalraan Gatherer's Lore
text: You have a deep understanding of plants, and you rarely make mistakes about them. You become trained in Life Science Lore and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you get a critical failure on a Life Science Lore or Nature check to Recall Knowledge about plants, you get a failure instead.

name: Izalraan Hunter's Shot
text: Frequency once per round You use the shot of your weapon to help your allies hunt down prey. Strike a creature undetected by one or more of your allies, but not undetected to you. If you hit the target, you [[/act point-out]] the creature to your allies.

name: Izalraan Leader's Ingenuity
text: You're entrusted with keeping your society's advanced technology a secret. You can modify one item with the tech trait as a 1-hour activity. Once modified, a creature must use a [[/act seek]] action to attempt a Crafting or Perception check against your Crafting DC to recognize that the item has the tech trait. Otherwise, it appears as an item with the analog trait, even if they see it used. The disguised item must appear to be the same general type of item, such as disguising a fangblade as a greatsword or a hypopen as an herbal remedy. Some items might be too high-tech to disguise as an analog item and can be disguised as a magic item instead, but doing so allows other creatures to use Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion to attempt to determine the item's true nature.

name: Jester's Trick
text: You excel at shell games, mimicry, and other jests or tricks involving misdirection, so much so that you have gained the magical ability to misdirect your foes' attacks to illusory duplicates. You can cast Mirror Image once per hour as an innate arcane spell.

name: Jet
text: Requirements You aren't encumbered. Whether expelling air or water, your siphons enable quick bursts of speed. You Leap, Stride, or Swim in a straight line, gaining a +10-foot status bonus to your Speeds during that movement. After you use Jet, you can't do so again for 1d4 rounds. You can't Jet in a vacuum and similar environments that lack air or fluid you can expel.

name: Join Dreamscape
text: You enter a creature's dreamscape to deliver a message, or enter a nearby creature's dreamscape more immersively. You can cast Dream Message once per day as an innate occult spell. If the target of your dream message is a sleeping and dreaming creature within 30 feet, the effect gains a duration of sustained, and you can send a dream self to enter their dream and remain there as long as you keep Sustaining the effect and they continue dreaming, to the normal maximum of 10 minutes to Sustain a Spell. During this time, you are an observer in their dreamscape, but you can deliver messages to them, and they can respond to you. You can't otherwise interact with their dreamscape, but it also can't harm you.

name: Jolted Alive
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You take electricity damage. What electrocutes other species, you instead consider an energizing snack. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level or your electricity resistance, whichever is greater. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Jungle Adaptation
text: You're part of a colony that builds inside massive trees rather than below the ground. You become trained in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Nature or Survival (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a climb Speed of 5 feet. Special If you take the Climbing Specialist ancestry feat, you gain a climb Speed of 30 feet instead of 20 feet.

name: Junkyard Resistance
text: You resist the most common hazards of your unsavory habitat. Choose one damage type: acid, piercing, or poison. You gain resistance equal to half your level to that damage type. Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a different damage type.

name: Just Happy to Help!
text: Helping your companions gives you a rush that no common drug could replicate. After you successfully Aid an ally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks using the same skill for 10 minutes.

name: Just Kidding
text: Trigger An ally critically fails to Coerce, Make an Impression, or Request. You attempt to play off a social misstep as a joke. Attempt a Performance check against the same DC as your ally's check. If you succeed, your ally treats their critical failure as a failure.

name: Just Like Rehearsal
text: Life often imitates art, and you've learned to deploy your dramatic training in dangerous situations, whether it's using your talent for pratfalls to cushion a real drop or faking out an enemy with your improv antics. You gain the feat, ignoring the prerequisites. In addition, you can use Performance instead of Deception to [[/act create-a-diversion skill=performance]].

name: Just Like Rehersal
text: Life often imitates art, and you've learned to deploy your dramatic training in dangerous situations.

name: Just the Thing...
text: Cost the Price of the chosen item You've traveled far and wide, bringing supplies and equipment from place to place and picking up interesting objects in your travels. In fact, you've got an interesting item right… here! You Interact to pull an item you hadn't previously declared that you purchased out of your pocket—this item must be any common item of half your level or less with a Bulk of 1 or less. It must be a piece of adventuring gear (from the table in Starfinder Player Core or other sources of adventuring gear) and can't be a weapon, armor, ammunition, magic item, pharmaceutical item, or other treasure.

name: Kalo Lore
text: Growing up among the blooms and glowing spires of Kalo-Mahoi has instilled in you a deep appreciation of the beauty around you, both natural and constructed. You're trained in Crafting and Nature. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Kalo Lore.

name: Kasatha Lore
text: You've studied the kasathan traditions of balance and harmony. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Kasatha Lore.

name: Kasatha Weapon Elegance
text: You've learned how to adapt your martial expertise to wield other weapons. When wielding a weapon you aren't proficient with, treat your level as your proficiency bonus. At 11th level, you become trained in all weapons.

name: Kasathan Weapon Familiarity
text: You have a respect for melee combat, and you've trained to wield a few more elegant examples in battle. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kasatha trait. You have familiarity with weapons with the kasatha trait plus the dueling sword, plasma sword, shock truncheon, and singing spear—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its critical specialization effect.

name: Keen Eyes
text: Your eyes are sharp. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Seek hidden or concealed creatures within 30 feet, and reduce the DC to find them.

name: Keep Rolling
text: Nothing can stop a talphi who doesn't want to be stopped. If you Stride immediately before attempting to [[/act tumble-through]] an enemy's space, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the attempt. If you critically succeed, your enemy's space isn't considered difficult terrain.

name: Keep Them in Your Sights
text: You always keep a target marked and in your sights, even if they move. When you Aim, the benefits apply if your mark is within your weapon's first or second range increment, rather than only within the first.

name: Khizar Lore
text: Whether in isolation or in communion with others of your kind, you've contemplated the nature of your ancestry for many years. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore feat for Khizar Lore.

name: Kick it Into Overdrive
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger Your turn begins. With a steadying breath and a moment of intense focus, you push yourself beyond your limits, gaining incredible speed for a short period of time. You become Quickened until the end of your turn, and you can use the extra action only to Stride. When you use this ability, you can instead choose to become quickened until the end of your next turn, but at the end of this duration, you become Fatigued for 2 rounds as your body recovers. You can still only use the extra action from quickened to Stride with this effect.

name: Kill Shot
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You take careful aim at your mark and shoot to kill. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against your mark. If this attack is a success (but not a critical success), you deal maximum damage. Calculate this damage as if every die you would roll has a maximum result. On a critical success, roll the result normally, but if the double damage would be less than the result of a maximum damage on a normal success, use the maximum damage on the success instead. If you spent 3 actions and your attack was a critical success, then you deal maximum damage and double the damage of that result as normal.

If you spent 3 actions and your attack was a critical success, then you deal maximum damage and double the damage of that result as normal.

name: Kill Steal
text: Trigger An ally ends their turn after hitting a creature two or more times or critically hitting a creature. Requirements You're wielding a gun. You fire a quick shot at a foe your ally is focusing their attacks on. You Aim at the creature your triggering ally hit and then make a ranged Strike against that creature.
