name: Kindle Blaze
text: Trigger You take fire damage. Be they solar rays or blazing flames, light and heat are a part of you. For 1 minute, you glow from within, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius (and dim light to the next 30 feet). While you glow in this way, your body is flush with warmth—you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against attacks, spells, and other effects that have the cold trait.

name: Kinesthetic Awareness
text: You have an exceedingly precise control over your body. When you succeed at a check to [[/act balance]], you get a critical success instead. If you roll a critical failure at a check to Balance, you get a failure instead.

name: Kip Up
text: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

name: Kiss it Better
text: Requirements You have a hand free and are adjacent to an ally who isn't at full Hit Points. You perform a token medical effort to convince an ally they've recovered from an injury. Attempt a Deception check with the same DC as for Treat Wounds. On a success, the target gains temporary Hit Points equal to half the corresponding amount of Hit Points from Treat Wounds. These temporary Hit Points last 1 round. Kiss It Better doesn't remove the wounded condition. The target is temporarily immune to Kiss It Better for 24 hours.

name: Knight of Golarion Dedication
text:
You have familiarity with all weapons in the sword weapon group. For the purposes of proficiency, treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons. If you are at least expert, you gain that weapon's critical specialization effect. You've studied lost Golarion's ancient cultures. You become trained in two of the following that you were not already trained in: Golarion Lore, Iomedae Lore, or a Lore skill associated with an ancestry or culture from Lost Golarion, such as Goblin, Halfling, Human, or Orc.

Knight of Golarion

name: Know Your Audience
text: You always have an uncanny knack for understanding your audience. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive rollOption="know-your-audience"]] if your target's attitude toward you is indifferent or better.

name: Know-It-All
text: Your breadth of knowledge is impressive. When you succeed at a Recall Knowledge check, you gain additional context or detail beyond the basic answer.

name: Knowledge Bomb
text: You spew information about a topic you're passionate about that no one asked for. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you're aware of. Attempt a Lore check against that target's Will DC. Regardless of your result, the creature is temporarily immune to your attempts to Knowledge Bomb it for 10 minutes. Critical Success The creature becomes Stupefied 2 for 1 round. Success The creature becomes Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

name: Knowledge Module
text: You can temporarily upload additional skills thanks to your semi-technological nature. During your daily preparations, you become trained in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

name: Korasha Self-Perfection
text: You have perfected what it means to be a korasha and embody lashunta values around physical strength and might. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you succeed at an attempt to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]], you critically succeed instead.

name: Labyrinthine Mind
text: Your true feelings and thoughts are tucked away in the twisting corridors of your mind, such that you and, more importantly, others have difficulty accessing them. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect or a spell, you get a critical success instead.

name: Land Feet First
text: You always seem to land on your feet. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you're already trained in that skill, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Cat Fall skill feat.

name: Land on your Foe
text: Requirements You are climbing on a surface at least 10 feet directly above a target. You leap down on your target with all the acrobatic grace of a falling squox. You attempt to [[/act trip skill=acrobatics]] the target using Acrobatics instead of Athletics, then land in an unoccupied space of your choice adjacent to the target.

name: Large Reach
text: Using your large size, you can extend your reach to attack targets that are farther away. When you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed stretch using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended stretch gain a reach of 10 feet.

name: Lashunta Lore
text: You've studied the lives and achievements of other lashuntas who have improved both their psychic powers and their communities. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Occultism and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Lashunta Lore.

name: Lashunta Magic
text: You can tap into your latent psychic power. You gain daze and detect thoughts as innate spells you can cast once per day each.

name: Lasting Coercion
text: When you successfully Coerce someone, the maximum time they comply increases to a week, still determined by the GM. If you're legendary, the maximum increases to a month.

name: Latch On
text: Requirements You have a creature Grabbed with your jaws. Having two mouths to feed is said to take more energy, and you're no exception. You make a jaws Strike against the grabbed creature. On a hit, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

name: Launch Plasma
text: Frequency once per day You can launch a ball of plasma and stellar ejecta across the battlefield that explodes on impact, raining plasma and flame in a small area. Launch Plasma deals ] damage in a within 60 feet. Each creature in the area must attempt a reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a critical failure, a creature also takes ] damage. At 7th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the fire damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent electricity damage increases by 1. At 17th level, the area increases to a . Special If you're a Volatile Novian, Launch Plasma and Mini-Nova's damage dice are both increased to d8s.

name: Launching Jump
text: Requirements You're in quadrupedal posture. You use the momentum from lifting yourself up into bipedal posture to propel yourself into a high leap. You Change Posture from quadrupedal to bipedal and [[/act high-jump]] or Leap with a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics. You don't automatically fail if you don't Stride as part of the activity. You remain in bipedal posture when you land. Special If you have the Quick Jump skill feat, this activity is also reduced to 1 action.

name: Leader's Confidence
text: You gain the Leader's Confidence class feature.

name: Leading Role
text: Frequency once per hour You played a leading role in a long-running, popular production, and you frequently like to fall back on this character to get through difficult situations. You can roll a Performance check in place of a skill check to accomplish any other task.

name: Leap Strike
text: You combine your extraordinary leap with a deadly attack. When you leap at least 10 feet, you can make a melee Strike at the apex or landing point without taking a multiple attack penalty.

name: Leaping Expertise
text: Controlling your body as you fly through the air has become second nature. You can Leap greater distances horizontally by spending additional actions. If you do, increase the limit on how far you can Leap by 5 feet for each additional action spent. Additionally, you can [[/act long-jump]] in a different direction than the direction you were Striding. Special When you Fly using a jet pack or jump jets while your feet are on the ground, you can spring upward to increase your fly Speed by 10 feet for the duration of the move action.

name: Learned From the Tunnels
text: You've managed to hone your prior experience in the tunnels of Apostae and can employ them when faced with almost any hazard or environmental threat. You can use your Apostae delver heritage to reroll on traps every hour instead of every day. In addition, you can use this reroll against any effect caused by a hazard, instead of just traps.

name: Learning Experience
text: Your body can partially absorb persistent damage to learn from it. Before you roll damage from a persistent effect, you can choose to take half damage from the effect. When you do, you automatically fail your flat check to end the persistent damage and you can immediately Recall Knowledge as a free action to recall information related to the source of the persistent damage. If you have any special abilities or free actions that would normally be triggered when you Recall Knowledge, you can't use them with this action.

name: Leg Brain
text: You've got a brain or two that can control especially long or nimble "legs" or otherwise give you increased locomotion. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.

name: Legacy of Betrayal
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're about to attempt a saving throw against an enemy's ability. Requirements You believed the triggering enemy was your ally within the last hour. You understand deeply that others can never be trusted. Reroll the triggering saving throw. You must use the second result, even if it's worse.

name: Legend Weaver
text: You're an incredibly talented storyteller, making legends come to life. You gain Illusory Scene as a 6th-rank occult innate spell. You can cast this spell once per day. When you cast illusory scene in this way, the spell automatically adapts to suit its audience. A deaf creature that witnesses the illusion additionally sees the characters in the scene visually signing their dialogue. A blind creature that witnesses the illusion additionally hears an audio description of the scene. A deafblind creature that witnesses the illusion additionally receives a psychic impression of the scene and its dialogue in their mind.

name: Legendary Codebreaker
text: Your skill with languages and codes is so great that you can decipher information with little more than a quick read through a text. You can Decipher Writing using Society while reading at normal speed. If you slow down and spend the full amount of time that's ordinarily required and roll a success, you get a critical success; if you critically succeed while spending the normal amount of time, you gain a nearly word-for-word understanding of the document.

name: Legendary Linguist
text: You're so skilled with languages you can create a pidgin instantly. You can always talk to any creature that has a language—even a language you don't know—by creating a new pidgin language that uses simplified terms and conveys basic concepts. To do so, you must first understand at least what medium of communication the creature uses (speech, sign language, and so on).

name: Legendary Medic
text: You've discovered medical breakthroughs or techniques that achieve miraculous results. Once per day for each target, you can spend 1 hour treating that target and attempt a Medicine check to remove a disease or the Blinded, Deafened, Doomed, or Drained condition. Use the DC of the disease or of the spell or effect that created the condition. If the effect's source is an artifact, above 20th level, or similarly powerful, increase the DC by 10.

name: Legendary Negotiation
text: You can negotiate incredibly quickly in adverse situations. You attempt to Make an Impression and then Request your opponent cease their current activity and engage in negotiations. You take a –5 penalty to your Diplomacy check. Generally, the DC of this check is the creature's Will DC, although your GM may modify it based on the situation. Some creatures may be unable to stop regardless of their personal desires, and even those who agree to parley might ultimately find your arguments lacking and return to violence.

name: Legendary Performer
text: Your fame has spread throughout the galaxy. Creatures who have any listed skill in Society have heard of you and usually have an attitude toward you one step better than normal, depending on your reputation and the creature's disposition. For instance, if you're well-known for cruel and demanding behavior, creatures might be intimidated by you, rather than be friendly toward you. When you Earn Income with Performance, you attract higher-level audiences than your location would allow, as audiences flock to see you. For instance, famous socialites and spectra might travel to a dive bar in a backwater port to hear you perform. Typically, this increases the audiences available to your level or by two levels, whichever is higher.

name: Legendary Professional
text: Your fame has spread throughout the galaxy (for instance, if you have Warfare Lore, you might be a legendary general or tactician). This works as Legendary Performer, except you gain higher-level jobs when you Earn Income with Lore.

name: Legendary Sneak
text: You're always sneaking unless you choose to be seen, even when there's nowhere to hide. You can Hide and Sneak even without cover or being Concealed. When you employ an exploration tactic other than Avoiding Notice, you also gain the benefits of Avoiding Notice unless you choose not to.

name: Legendary Survivalist
text: You can survive indefinitely without food or water and can endure severe, extreme, and incredible cold and heat without taking damage from doing so.

name: Legendary Thief
text: Your ability to Steal defies belief. You can attempt to Steal something that is actively wielded or that would be extremely noticeable or time consuming to remove (like worn shoes or armor). You must do so slowly and carefully, spending at least 1 minute (and significantly longer for items that are normally time consuming to remove, like armor). Throughout this duration you must have some means of staying Hidden, such as the cover of darkness or a bustling crowd. Even if you succeed, if the item is extremely prominent—like a suit of full plate armor—onlookers will quickly notice it's gone after you steal it.

name: Legendary Troll
text: Requirements You or your target are using a comm unit, datapad, or other computer. Attempt a Deception check against the Will DC of a target within 60 feet. On a success, the target is Off-Guard for 1 round, and on a critical success, it's Confused for 1 round. The target's reaction gives you information about it as though you'd attempted to Recall Knowledge using an appropriate skill and received the same result on your roll. The target is then temporarily immune to your Legendary Troll attempts for 24 hours.

name: Lengthy Diversion
text: Your diversions last much longer than normal. When you successfully Create a Diversion, the effect lasts until the end of your turn rather than just on that action.

name: Leshy Roots
text: You are closer to your leshy roots than other leshy dragons. You gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat, for the leshy ancestry, even though that feat is normally only available for common ancestries, and you also gain one 1st-level leshy ancestry feat. You can take leshy ancestry feats that require your corresponding leshy heritage (leaf leshy for arboreal dragon, lotus leshy for floral dragon, gourd leshy for harvest dragon, seaweed leshy for kelp dragon, or fungus leshy for toadstool dragon), and any feats that affect fungi or plants based on leshy heritage like Ritual Reversion and Speak with Kindred match the corresponding leshy heritage.

name: Let It Ride
text: Building perfect luck is a lifelong quest, and you push farther and farther down that shimmering road; you've gained more control over your natural luck than ever before, and you can use it to manipulate your lucky number with greater precision. You can choose your lucky number instead of rolling.

name: Let's Go
text: Frequency once per day Your boundless enthusiasm is infectious, and you can share some of that energy and can-do attitude with your allies. You and all allies within 60 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed and the Quickened condition for 4 rounds. Creatures can use the extra action each round only to Stride. Special If you have the Supersonic Speed feat, you and each ally gain concealment until the start of their next turn if they Stride while quickened from Let's Go. As usual for concealment involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]].

name: Let's Jam
text: Frequency once per hour You spin up your musical instruments to drop the bass and pick up the pace. All allies within 30 feet who can perceive you can [[/act step]], [[/act stride]] up to half their speed, or [[/act take-cover]] as a reaction.
